programs.title: A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood
programs.desc: Lloyd Vogel (Matthew Rhys) is in crisis.His marriage to Andrea (Susan Kelechi Watson) is not going well.His son was recently born and he can't quite cope with the role of a parent.His wife, in turn, completely lost patience with his moods.He is also stressed by his relationship with his father, Jerry (Chris Cooper).She cannot forgive him for abandoning his family in the past and leaving him alone with his sick mother.Things aren't going well at work either.An aspiring investigative journalist is given a task by his superior that is below his skills.He is to prepare a short article as part of a series about inspiring people.He comes to interview the nationally beloved children's show host, Fred Rogers (Tom Hanks).Without any enthusiasm, he meets America's favorite, who immediately surprises him with his cheerfulness.Suddenly, the roles in their relationship are reversed.While it was Lloyd who was supposed to question Rogers, it was Rogers who steered the conversation and got him to confess.A friendship develops between the men.Under the influence of meetings with Fred, Vogel rediscovers the joy of life and begins to believe that he can repair relationships with his loved ones and experience happiness.A film inspired by a true story.

programs.title: Wolfgang (extraordinari)
programs.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, nine-year-old Wolfgang (Jordi Catalán), an exceptionally gifted boy with features on the autism spectrum, is forced to live with his father, Carles (Miki Esparbé), whom he has never met before.An orderly nine-year-old who strives for perfection cannot stand his father's chaotic lifestyle.He wants to escape to Paris to study at the Grimald Academy and become the best pianist in the world.When Carles discovers his plan, he must make the most important decision in his life: follow his dream of an acting career or sacrifice his plans and become the father Wolfgang really needs.

programs.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programs.desc: Sarah (Margot Robbie) and David (Colin Farrell) meet at a friend's wedding.They go on an expedition during which they relive the most important moments from their past.

programs.title: Bird
programs.desc: 12-year-old Bailey (Nykiya Adams), her brother Hunter (Jason Buda) and her dad Bug (Barry Keoghan) live illegally in an abandoned building.The father doesn't have much time for the children.He is busy preparing for the wedding with his stepmother, whom they dislike, and looking for easy money.The mother became involved with an aggressive partner.Bailey also finds no support among her peers and becomes increasingly alienated.Her love for birds is her salvation.The girl spends more and more time alone in nature.One day she meets a tramp, Bird (Franz Rogowski), who asks her for help... Behind the camera, Andrea Arnold, director of "Fish Tank" and "American Honey" and the documentary "Cow".

programs.title: Rumble Through the Dark
programs.desc: Jack Boucher (Aaron Eckhart), once an undefeated boxer, now lives in poverty, tormented by memories of the orphanage.In debt to Big Momma Sweet (Marianne Jean-Baptiste), he tries to win at the casino.

programs.title: Holland
programs.desc: Nancy Vandergroot (Nicole Kidman) tries to fulfill her duties as a housewife perfectly.She lives a seemingly perfect life with her husband (Matthew Macfadyen) and son (Jude Hill) in the tulip-filled town of Holland, Michigan.He is an important member of a close-knit community.One day, the woman and her friend Dave (Gael García Bernal) discover a secret.They begin to suspect that nothing in their lives is what it seems.While searching for the dark truth, they expose themselves to danger.The film was directed by Mimi Cave, who made her debut in 2022 with the horror film "Fresh", well received by critics and viewers.
